entities.name: PMID:27501330
observations: PARIS prospective birth-cohort study; allergen-specific IgE to 12 food and 4 inhalant allergens measured at 18 months (positive ≥0.35 kUA/L); 1,525 infants classified by early sensitization profile.

At age 2, doctor-diagnosed asthma, rhinitis, eczema, food allergy, and multimorbidity increased across sensitization profiles (p-trend <0.001); at age 6, allergic symptoms and multimorbidity were more frequent in the more sensitized profiles.

entities.name: Early sensitization-multimorbidity
observations: In PARIS infants, early polysensitization was associated with more frequent allergic multimorbidity as early as age 2; greater sensitization-profile severity showed increasing multimorbidity prevalence (p-trend <0.001). The abstract does not report an effect size or adjusted odds ratio.
